name: oxford-dictionary
title: Dictionary & Thesaurus
description: Search definitions, word types (noun, verb, adj), pronunciations, and synonyms with offline support.
author: johnathan_w

commands.name: def
commands.title: Define Word
commands.subtitle: Word meanings, type, pronunciation & synonyms
commands.description: Look up definitions, word types (noun, verb, adjective, etc.), pronunciation, and synonyms.

commands.name: pronounce
commands.title: Pronounce Word
commands.subtitle: Audio pronunciation in background
commands.description: Pronounce word in background without opening any browser or window.

commands.name: roget
commands.title: Roget's Thesaurus
commands.subtitle: Roget's Thesaurus (rrthesaurus.com)
commands.description: Browse and search all 1,000 categories of Roget's Thesaurus 1911 edition from rrthesaurus.com with number navigation and full-text search.

commands.name: wrd
commands.title: Reverse Dictionary
commands.subtitle: Reverse definition & concept search
commands.description: Find words by describing what you mean or searching definition fragments (e.g. 'to put forward', 'fear of spiders').

commands.name: vec
commands.title: Vector Synonym Search
commands.subtitle: Vector semantic synonym search
commands.description: Find words and synonyms ordered by semantic vector closeness to a set of words.

preferences.name: offlineOnly
preferences.title: Offline Mode
preferences.label: Force offline mode (disable online enrichment)
preferences.description: When enabled, lookups only use the offline database and local cache.

preferences.name: preferOxford
preferences.title: macOS Oxford Dictionary
preferences.label: Use macOS native Oxford Dictionary when available
preferences.description: If running on macOS, accesses Apple's built-in Oxford Dictionary.

scripts.build: ray build -e dist -o dist && node build-sync.js
scripts.test: tsx tests/test-dictionary.ts && tsx tests/test-roget.ts && tsx tests/test-reverse.ts && tsx tests/test-vector.ts
